:::{#def-convex-hull}
#### Convex hull, convex envelope

The **convex hull** (or **convex envelope**)
[@wikipedia_convex_hull]
of a [set](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/sets.html#def-set) $S \subseteq \reals^p$ is the set of points that lie in every [convex set](#def-convex-set) containing $S$:

$$
\operatorname{conv}(S) \eqdef \cb{\vx \in \reals^p : \vx \in K \text{ for every convex } K \subseteq \reals^p \text{ with } S \subseteq K}.
$$

:::
